name: C-Psych Fit Check

P_E.label: Extraversion
P_E.source: IPIP-50 Big-Five Factor Markers (Goldberg, 1992); public domain; plain-English adaptation (FC-1.2)

CP_clan.label: Prefers Clan (collaborate)
CP_clan.source: provisional; Competing Values Framework constructs (Quinn & Rohrbaugh, 1983)

personality.title: How you see yourself
personality.intro: Describe yourself as you usually are now, not as you would like to be. Compare yourself with other people of about your age. Please be honest: your answers are private.

motives.title: What motivates you at work
motives.intro: How much do you agree with each sentence about what is important to you at work?

style.title: Your working style and preferred culture
style.intro: How much do you agree with each sentence about how you like to work?

pressure.title: You under pressure
pressure.intro: Think about times at work when you were under a lot of pressure, very tired or stressed. How much do you agree with each sentence?

org.title: Your organisation's culture
org.intro: Describe your organisation as it really is in daily work, not how it is described officially.

team.title: Your team's culture
team.intro: Describe your team (or the team you would join) as it really works every day.

criteria.title: Your experience at work
criteria.intro: These questions help us check whether the tool matches real experience. There are no right or wrong answers.

changelog: FC-1.1: culture items (CP, OR, TC, OE) reworded as concrete, original behavioural statements to keep clear of the wording of proprietary culture instruments. Do not pool these items with FC-1.0 pilot data.

FC-1.2: every item, answer label and block introduction rewritten in plain English (short sentences, common words, no idioms) for non-native speakers. The IPIP-50 items are a plain-English adaptation with the same content and keying; confirm reliability and convergent validity before comparing with published IPIP norms.
